params.body:
Eighth measurement to carry verdicts.

| facet | thresholds, worst first |
| --- | --- |
| running | `SERVER_STOPPED` (week), `SERVERS_RUNNING` (ok) |
| backups | `BACKUPS_MISSING` (week), `BACKUPS_ON` (ok) |
| sizing | `SERVERS_OVERSIZED` (background), `SERVERS_FIT` (ok) |

Three counts over the project's machines make these registry matters (`serversStopped`, `serversNoBackup`, `serversOversized`); `serversNoBackup` was a threshold field nothing measured, it is measured now. Each machine carries `oversized: true` when the registry's `SERVER_OVERSIZED` fires on its thirty-day peak, so the Servers card maps a word; a machine whose meter could not be read carries no mark.

Levels copied from Portal's Servers and Backups cards. Tests: two cases in `ServersScanTest`. Suite 613 green, PHPStan and Pint clean. Portal follows with Servers, Backups and the CPU lines in Speed reading the words.
params.title: Servers judges its own facts: running, backed up, sized to their load
